description: This file defines the SearchAndEntityCollection class, a wrapper around a SearchQueryContributor and a collection of entity classes, used within Hibernate search to facilitate search queries involving multiple entity types.

classes.name: SearchAndEntityCollection
classes.description: A generic wrapper class that holds a SearchQueryContributor and a collection of entity classes to be used in search queries.

methods.name: SearchAndEntityCollection
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a query contributor and a collection of entity classes.

methods.name: setFinalPredicate
methods.description: Sets the final search predicate using a provided function.

methods.name: getFinalPredicate
methods.description: Retrieves the current final predicate function.

methods.name: getEntityCollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of entity classes associated with this search wrapper.
